name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Raven does not go with Human if and only if Halfling goes with Rogue.
Human goes with at most one of Sable, Druid, and Raven.
Gnome, Raven, and Viper go with Sable, Paladin, and Rogue, in some order.
Druid goes with exactly two of Wrenna, Human, and Viper.
Barbarian, Druid, and Rogue go with Halfling, Hawk, and Viper, in some order.
Raven goes with at least two of Thorne, Halfling, and Barbarian.

hints.text: Suppose Paladin went with Hawk — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.

Hawk goes with Paladin, so Barbarian can't go with Hawk.

…but now the clue “Barbarian, Druid, and Rogue go with Halfling, Hawk, and Viper, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Paladin does not go with Hawk.
